counterfactual_text: The dry dandelion head becomes depleted before the gust reaches it, and the detached seeds begin drifting afterward.
positive_text: The gust reaches the dry dandelion, seeds detach progressively from the head, drift away, and leave the same seed head visibly depleted.
semantic_text: A gust blows across a dry dandelion, detaching seeds that drift away while the seed head becomes depleted. Initial scene: A fixed close side view of one full dry dandelion seed head outdoors, with all fine seeds visibly attached to the central head. The stem, complete seed head, and broad empty space on one side are unobstructed against a simple natural background under neutral daylight. Required visible entities: one dry dandelion; full attached seed head; visible stem. At the beginning: dandelion seed head: full, dry, intact, and densely covered with attached seeds; seeds: attached to the same central head. Required layout: complete seed head and stem fit inside the frame; broad empty space extends on the intended drift side; individual outer seeds remain visually distinguishable. Required state changes: seed attachment: attached to detached; seed positions: head to drifting away; seed-head fullness: full to depleted. These event variables are allowed to change: seed attachment state; seed positions; seed-head fullness. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; dandelion stem and central-head identity; simple natural background; one dry dandelion seed head; the same seeds and stem; the same outdoor scene.
